title: Calculator Functions
prompt: Write typed add and multiply functions with numeric parameters and numeric return values.

starter.code:
// TODO: write function add(a: number, b: number): number
// TODO: write function multiply(a: number, b: number): number

public_tests.name: Required type contract
public_tests.description: Review that the submission contains the required declarations and preserves the stated input/output relationship.
required_strings: function add(a: number, b: number): number
function multiply(a: number, b: number): number

public_tests.name: Runtime and boundary review
public_tests.description: Explain one failure case and add a real runtime check when data crosses an external trust boundary.

acceptance_criteria: Both functions return a number for numeric inputs.
Submit code with the required type declarations and add an explanation or test for one meaningful boundary/failure case.
Do not claim that the code has been executed by the CodeLeaf browser playground.
hints: Annotate the parameters and return type; do not return a formatted string from a numeric function.
TypeScript checks assignability but does not validate external data at runtime.
Use the local TypeScript compiler and an appropriate test runner to verify behavior; the course grader checks only the documented text markers.

required_strings: function add(a: number, b: number): number
function multiply(a: number, b: number): number

grading_method: Server-side static token check for the required declarations plus human review of runtime tests. This is not a TypeScript compiler or arbitrary-code runner.
retry_policy: Unlimited practice retries; platform XP is awarded once only after a correct server-side grade.
status_note: Draft until exercise instructions, starter, and static grader are reviewed. No course-authored XP override is used.
